title: Paired coordinate product
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $w$ be a Boolean vector of length $2m$, and let $i$ be an index with $0\le i<m$. The paired bit at $i$ is the product in $\mathbb{F}_2$ of the Boolean values in positions $i$ and $i+m$, after identifying Boolean values with elements of $\mathbb{F}_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean vector of length $2m$
